# Ayamil Coders

> Ayamil Coders is a registered Pakistan-based software company in Sadiqabad, Punjab. The company builds custom software and provides web development, AI integration, blockchain development and bug fixing services for businesses.

- Website: https://ayamilcoders.com/
- Legal entity: AYAMIL CODERS (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED
- Company origin: Founded July 21, 2023; the date is the birthday of the Hidden Partner, Ayamil Coders' Chief Executive Officer. Her real identity is intentionally private.
- Founder: Muhammad Muzamil
- Chief Executive Officer: The Hidden Partner (public professional title; personal identity not disclosed)
- Headquarters: Sadiqabad, Rahim Yar Khan, Punjab, Pakistan
- Primary service language: English; Urdu inquiries are welcome
